title: Understanding L1 Loss
text: L1 loss, also known as least absolute deviations, is minimized by the median of the data. This is because the median minimizes the sum of absolute deviations from the central value.

title: Identifying the Median
text: The median is the middle value of a data set when it is ordered. For the given statistics, the median of $$critic_1$$ is provided as $$82$$.
